python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, sys
root=pathlib.Path('.')
evid=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-23-20260923'
manifest_src=root/'.ai/task/repair-w23-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json'
manifest_dst=evid/'orchestration-pack-manifest.json'
assert manifest_dst.read_bytes()==manifest_src.read_bytes(), 'manifest copy differs'
d=json.loads(manifest_src.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(d['files'])==111
assert sum(x['bytes'] for x in d['files'])==d['total_bytes']==799095
for x in d['files']:
    src=root/x['source']; dst=evid/'orchestration'/x['relative_destination']
    sb=src.read_bytes(); db=dst.read_bytes()
    assert sb==db, f'pack byte mismatch: {dst}'
    assert len(db)==x['bytes'], f'pack size mismatch: {dst}'
    assert hashlib.sha256(db).hexdigest()==x['sha256'], f'pack sha mismatch: {dst}'
cat_src=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window23-20260923-candidate-catalog'
for src in sorted(p for p in cat_src.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    dst=root/src.relative_to(cat_src)
    assert dst.read_bytes()==src.read_bytes(), f'catalog copy differs: {dst}'
mig_src=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window23-20260923-migration.json'
mig_dst=root/'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/d2075cb1e0938d0607405e8d8d85400e38b06f9245584e5838e455993014585f.json'
assert mig_dst.read_bytes()==mig_src.read_bytes(), 'migration copy differs'
pub=evid/'publication'
for name in ['PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md','CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json','MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json','TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json','ADJUDICATION-R0.json','ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json']:
    assert (pub/name).read_bytes()==(root/'.ai/task/repair-w23-20260923'/name).read_bytes(), f'publication copy differs: {name}'
for name in ['queue-1.log','queue-1-timing.json','catalog.log','catalog-timing.json','migration.json','migration-timing.json','migration-run.log','migration-run-timing.json']:
    assert (pub/name).read_bytes()==(root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window'/('window23-20260923-'+name)).read_bytes(), f'publication log differs: {name}'
for path in [evid/'PUBLICATION.md', root/'handoff.md']:
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '\r' not in text, f'CR found: {path}'
    bad=[i for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if line.endswith((' ','\t'))]
    assert not bad, f'trailing whitespace: {path}:{bad}'
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):

        assert resolved.exists(), f'broken link: {path} -> {target}'
